verbatimFragment: "hero/skill/6010/1","Passive: When casting a weapon skill, apply a healing leaf to yourself and up to 3 allies nearby, restoring HP (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Treant's Max HP)\nShoots spikes outwards, with each spike dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) DMG."

"hero/skill/6010/2","Passive: When casting a weapon skill, apply a healing leaf to yourself and up to 3 allies nearby, restoring HP (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Treant's Max HP)\nShoots spikes outwards, with each spike dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) DMG, and applying a ${cfg.args.duration/1000}s Root effect to enemies [Root: Can’t move]."
'hero/skill/6010/1',"被动：释放武器技能时，向自己和附近友方单位（最多3个）各释放一片树叶，树叶提供${cfg.args.hpArgs}%树人最大生命值的治疗效果。\n向前方释放尖刺，每根尖刺造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害"

"hero/skill/6010/2","被动：释放武器技能时，向自己和附近友方单位（最多3个）各释放一片树叶，树叶提供${cfg.args.hpArgs}%树人最大生命值的治疗效果。\n向前方释放尖刺，每根尖刺造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害,并对敌人施加${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒的束缚状态【束缚：无法移动】"

'hero/skill/6010/3',"被动：释放武器技能时，向自己和附近友方单位（最多3个）各释放一片树叶，树叶提供${cfg.args.hpArgs}%树人最大生命值的治疗效果。\n向前方释放两次尖刺，每根尖刺造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害,并对敌人施加${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒的束缚状态【束缚：无法移动】"
